## SKIN INFORMATION

***

* Champion:Viego
* Modified skin: Base
* Author: Puls
* Version: 1.2.0
* Description: Combines the aesthetics of Pre-VGU Aatrox with the gameplay of Viego. The Mod uses Viegos animations along with aatroxes model. The mod features updated Loading Screen Art, VFX, SFX, Spell + HUD Icons and  Voice Over.

***

This is a bit of a meme, bit of a nostalgia-bait mod, but I feel as though Viego's gameplay does, at least moderately, suit the concept of a darkin weapon swapping bodies searching for a compatible host. Its a fun mod, and I miss old Aatrox so. yknow.

***

If the mod breaks or you have any questions feel free to reach out to me via discord (puls\_36) or on Twitter (ItsPulsLOL)
